apis_used.status: FAILED for all 5 DOIs in this run (repeated connection timeouts HTTP 000; two attempts returned HTTP 400). Not merged into forward.csv or union_dedup.csv this round. See failures below.

deduplication_rule: Grouped by PMID first; else by lower-cased DOI; else by normalized (lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed) exact title string for the small residual set with neither PMID nor DOI. No fuzzy title matching was attempted; this may under-merge paraphrased or OCR-variant citation strings for the no-PMID/no-DOI residual, which is disclosed as a limitation.
failures_and_limitations: OpenCitations Index (COCI/successor) could not be reached reliably from this environment: 3/5 DOIs timed out (HTTP 000) after retries, 2/5 (Simpson's OpenAlex-attributed DOI; Shi 2025) returned HTTP 400. No OpenCitations data is included in forward.csv or union_dedup.csv this round; PubMed elink and OpenAlex cited-by were used as the two forward sources actually merged.

Simpson 2020 (Exerc Immunol Rev, PMID 32139352) has no DOI asserted by the publisher per protocol section E; Crossref title search for this reference found no match; PubMed efetch XML has no <ReferenceList> for this record; OpenAlex referenced_works for this record is empty (0 entries). Backward chasing for Simpson 2020 therefore yielded 0 records in this round -- a documented source gap, not a coding error.

Peake 2017 and Simpson 2020 PubMed XML records carry no <ReferenceList>; Peake 2017 backward references were obtained via Crossref works/<doi> reference array instead (129 entries, 118 with a publisher-asserted DOI, 11 with author/year/journal/volume/page only and no DOI in Crossref -- these 11 are recorded as unresolved).

For DOI-only forward/backward records (no PMID in OpenAlex ids.pmid), no additional per-DOI PubMed ESearch-by-DOI pass was run in this round to recover PMIDs for very recent or non-MEDLINE-indexed citing works; these remain doi_only. This is a scope limitation, not an error, and can be tightened in round 2.
No fuzzy/approximate title matching, no author-name disambiguation, and no manual verification of any individual record occurred; this is an automated API merge only.
Eligibility was NOT assessed for any record in this round. Records are titles/DOIs/PMIDs/years/journals only -- no abstracts were retrieved or stored anywhere in this output.
